about_the_game:
You're hiring more and more people in your small company!

But that's not all — you have to find a way to make them all fit in their workspace. And on top of having very different shapes and sizes, they also have specific requests!

Take George, for example: he always wants to be next to the coffee machine.

Or Gwen and Grace — they're inseparable. Don’t even think about putting one on one side of the room and the other on the opposite side!

You get the idea — Cosy Company Puzzle is a challenging logic game! But in the end, everyone feels much better.

Key Features

  • Handcrafted levels
    90 handcrafted levels, some of which might really get your brain working.

  • Simple controls
    Everything is played with the mouse. Left click to move, right click to rotate. Nothing that should get in the way of your puzzle-solving!

  • Relaxing lo-fi music
    Plenty of music to soothe your ears and immerse you in a calm and thoughtful atmosphere.

  • A wholesome vibe
    Workplaces are often all about stress and productivity. But here, we take our time, listen to everyone, and embrace each person’s uniqueness.

  • Collectible cards
    The story unfolds through puzzles — but also through more than 70 collectible cards to unlock and enjoy!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 (or equivalent distribution)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1-compatible video card with 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra (or higher)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (dual-core)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 integrated GPU or equivalent
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: In this colorful 2D puzzle game, you take care of the employees in your small company by placing them on the grid according to their shape — and their specific preferences. The story of Cosy Company Puzzle will unfold gradually across 90 handcrafted levels.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Thai, Turkish
